title: Daniel 12 — Michael, the resurrection of many, and the sealed book until the time of the end

translation.sourceText: Daniel — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (MT BHS Codex Leningradensis Hebrew primary; 4Q114 (Danielc) preserves portions of ch 12 secondary, confirming the MT outline; 4Q174 (Florilegium) and 11Q13 (Melchizedek) demonstrate the Daniel-eschatology was foundational for Qumran sectarian thought. Old Greek + Theodotion-Greek tertiary, consulted at the calendrical figures vv 7, 11, 12; OG of ch 12 is one of the better-preserved sections; minor variants at v 13). Chapter 12 is Hebrew, the final chapter and the densest single concentration of cross-corpus-influential eschatology in the HB: (1) Michael's eschatological intervention (v 1) + the book of life; (2) the TWO-FOLD RESURRECTION (v 2) — the foundational HB resurrection text, with ḥayyê ʿōlām (everlasting life) vs dirʾôn ʿōlām (everlasting contempt); (3) the wise shining like stars (v 3); (4) the sealed book (vv 4, 9); (5) the three apocalyptic calendar-numbers: time, times, and half a time (v 7), 1290 days (v 11), 1335 days (v 12); (6) the closing individual-resurrection promise to Daniel (v 13).

paragraphs.text: וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִיא֩ יַעֲמֹ֨ד מִֽיכָאֵ֜ל הַשַּׂ֣ר הַגָּד֗וֹל הָעֹמֵד֮ עַל־בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּךָ֒ וְהָיְתָה֙ עֵ֣ת צָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־נִהְיְתָה֙ מִֽהְי֣וֹת גּ֔וֹי עַ֖ד הָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא וּבָעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ יִמָּלֵ֣ט עַמְּךָ֔ כָּל־הַנִּמְצָ֖א כָּת֥וּב בַּסֵּֽפֶר׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-ḇā-ʿēṯ ha-hîʾ yaʿămōḏ Mîḵāʾēl haś-śar hag-gāḏōl hā-ʿōmēḏ ʿal-bənê ʿammeḵā wə-hāyəṯāh ʿēṯ ṣārāh ʾăšer lōʾ-nihyəṯāh mi-hyōṯ gōy ʿaḏ hā-ʿēṯ ha-hîʾ ū-ḇā-ʿēṯ ha-hîʾ yim-mālēṭ ʿammə-ḵā kol-han-nimṣāʾ kāṯūḇ bas-sēp̄er

i18n.en: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time your people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

paragraphs.commentary: **MICHAEL STANDS UP** + the time of trouble + the **book of life** (the *sēfer*). Cross-corpus: Exod 32:32 + Ps 69:28 + Mal 3:16 + Phil 4:3 + Rev 3:5 + Rev 13:8 + Rev 20:12-15 + Rev 21:27. The Michael-eschatological-role + book-of-life pairing becomes a major NT eschatology motif.

paragraphs.text: וְרַבִּ֕ים מִיְּשֵׁנֵ֥י אַדְמַת־עָפָ֖ר יָקִ֑יצוּ אֵ֚לֶּה לְחַיֵּ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם וְאֵ֥לֶּה לַחֲרָפ֖וֹת לְדִרְא֥וֹן עוֹלָֽם׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-rabbîm miy-yəšēnê ʾaḏmaṯ-ʿāp̄ār yāqîṣū ʾēlleh lə-ḥayyê ʿōlām wə-ʾēlleh la-ḥărāp̄ōṯ lə-ḏirʾōn ʿōlām

i18n.en: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

paragraphs.commentary: **FOUNDATIONAL HEBREW BIBLE RESURRECTION**. Explicit two-fold: some to *ḥayyê ʿōlām* 'everlasting life' (only HB occurrence of this exact phrase); some to *dirʾôn ʿōlām* 'shame and everlasting contempt' (echoing Isa 66:24). Cross-corpus to Isa 26:19 (the prophetic-resurrection fountainhead) + 2 Macc 7 (the martyr-resurrection expansion) + Wis 3 + 1 En 22 + 2 Bar 30 + 4 Ezra 7 + Mark 12:25 + Jn 5:28-29 + 1 Cor 15 + 1 Thess 4:16 + Rev 20:5-15. *rabbîm* 'many' philological-ambiguity preserved (inclusive 'all' vs limited 'some').

paragraphs.text: וְהַ֨מַּשְׂכִּלִ֔ים יַזְהִ֖רוּ כְּזֹ֣הַר הָרָקִ֑יעַ וּמַצְדִּיקֵי֙ הָֽרַבִּ֔ים כַּכּוֹכָבִ֖ים לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-ham-maśkilîm yazhirū kə-zōhar hā-rāqîaʿ ū-maṣdîqê hā-rabbîm kak-kōḵāḇîm lə-ʿōlām wā-ʿeḏ

i18n.en: And they that are wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

paragraphs.commentary: 'Those who lead many to righteousness like the stars forever and ever.' Cross-corpus to Mt 13:43 + Phil 2:15 + 1 En 104:2 + 4Q521. The Hebrew *zōhar* 'brightness' (here, 'brightness of the firmament') becomes the namesake of the medieval Kabbalistic Zohar.

paragraphs.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה דָֽנִיֵּ֗אל סְתֹ֧ם הַדְּבָרִ֛ים וַחֲתֹ֥ם הַסֵּ֖פֶר עַד־עֵ֣ת קֵ֑ץ יְשֹׁטְט֥וּ רַבִּ֖ים וְתִרְבֶּ֥ה הַדָּֽעַת׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʾattāh Dāniyyēʾl səṯōm had-dəḇārîm wa-ḥăṯōm has-sēp̄er ʿaḏ-ʿēṯ qēṣ yəšōṭəṭū rabbîm wə-ṯirbeh had-dāʿaṯ

i18n.en: But you, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.

paragraphs.commentary: **THE SEALED BOOK** until the time of the end. Daniel sealed; **Rev 22:10 REVERSES** ('do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is near'). The sealed book of Dan 12 becomes the sealed scroll of Rev 5:1 that only the Lamb is worthy to open. Cross-corpus to Jub heavenly-tablets cluster.

paragraphs.text: וְרָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל וְהִנֵּ֛ה שְׁנַ֥יִם אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֹמְדִ֑ים אֶחָ֥ד הֵ֙נָּה֙ לִשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְאֹ֔ר וְאֶחָ֥ד הֵ֖נָּה לִשְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-rāʾîṯî ʾănî Dāniyyēʾl wə-hinnēh šənayim ʾăḥērîm ʿōmḏîm ʾeḥāḏ hēnnāh li-śp̄aṯ hay-yəʾōr wə-ʾeḥāḏ hēnnāh li-śp̄aṯ hay-yəʾōr

i18n.en: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, there stood two others, the one on the brink of the river on this side, and the other on the brink of the river on that side.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לָאִישׁ֙ לְב֣וּשׁ הַבַּדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִמַּ֖עַל לְמֵימֵ֣י הַיְאֹ֑ר עַד־מָתַ֖י קֵ֥ץ הַפְּלָאֽוֹת׃
paragraphs.translit: way-yōmer lā-ʾîš ləḇūš hab-baddîm ʾăšer mim-maʿal lə-mêmê hay-yəʾōr ʿaḏ-māṯay qēṣ hap-pəlāʾōṯ

i18n.en: And one said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, "How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?"

paragraphs.text: וָאֶשְׁמַ֞ע אֶת־הָאִ֣ישׁ ׀ לְב֣וּשׁ הַבַּדִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִמַּעַל֮ לְמֵימֵ֣י הַיְאֹר֒ וַיָּ֨רֶם יְמִינ֤וֹ וּשְׂמֹאלוֹ֙ אֶל־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע בְּחֵ֣י הָעוֹלָ֑ם כִּי֩ לְמוֹעֵ֨ד מֽוֹעֲדִ֜ים וָחֵ֗צִי וּכְכַלּ֛וֹת נַפֵּ֥ץ יַד־עַם־קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּכְלֶ֥ינָה כָל־אֵֽלֶּה׃
paragraphs.translit: wā-ʾešmaʿ ʾeṯ-hā-ʾîš ləḇūš hab-baddîm ʾăšer mim-maʿal lə-mêmê hay-yəʾōr way-yārem yəmînō ū-śəmōʾlō ʾel-haš-šāmayim way-yiš-šāḇaʿ bə-ḥê hā-ʿōlām kî lə-mōʿēḏ mōʿăḏîm wā-ḥēṣî ū-ḵə-ḵallōṯ nappēṣ yaḏ-ʿam-qōḏeš tiḵleynāh ḵol-ʾēlleh

i18n.en: And I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and swore by him that lives for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and a half; and when they have made an end of breaking in pieces the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.

paragraphs.text: וַאֲנִ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אָבִ֑ין וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה אֲדֹנִ֕י מָ֖ה אַחֲרִ֥ית אֵֽלֶּה׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾănî šāmaʿtî wə-lōʾ ʾāḇîn wā-ʾōmərāh ʾăḏōnî māh ʾaḥărîṯ ʾēlleh

i18n.en: And I heard, but I did not understand: then said I, "O my lord, what shall be the issue of these things?"

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֵ֣ךְ דָּנִיֵּ֑אל כִּֽי־סְתֻמִ֧ים וַחֲתֻמִ֛ים הַדְּבָרִ֖ים עַד־עֵ֥ת קֵֽץ׃
paragraphs.translit: way-yōmer lēḵ Dāniyyēʾl kî-səṯumîm wa-ḥăṯumîm had-dəḇārîm ʿaḏ-ʿēṯ qēṣ

i18n.en: And he said, "Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed till the time of the end.

paragraphs.text: יִ֠תְבָּֽרֲרוּ וְיִֽתְלַבְּנ֤וּ וְיִצָּֽרְפוּ֙ רַבִּ֔ים וְהִרְשִׁ֣יעוּ רְשָׁעִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֖ינוּ כָּל־רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְהַמַּשְׂכִּלִ֖ים יָבִֽינוּ׃
paragraphs.translit: yiṯ-bārărū wə-yiṯ-labbənū wə-yiṣ-ṣārəp̄ū rabbîm wə-hiršîʿū rəšāʿîm wə-lōʾ yāḇînū kol-rəšāʿîm wə-ham-maśkilîm yāḇînū

i18n.en: Many shall purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined; but the wicked shall do wickedly; and none of the wicked shall understand; but they that are wise shall understand.

paragraphs.text: וּמֵעֵת֙ הוּסַ֣ר הַתָּמִ֔יד וְלָתֵ֖ת שִׁקּ֣וּץ שֹׁמֵ֑ם יָמִ֕ים אֶ֖לֶף מָאתַ֥יִם וְתִשְׁעִֽים׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-mē-ʿēṯ hūsar hat-tāmîḏ wə-lā-ṯēṯ šiqqūṣ šōmēm yāmîm ʾelep̄ māʾṯayim wə-ṯišʿîm

i18n.en: And from the time that the continual burnt-offering shall be taken away, and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.

paragraphs.commentary: **1290 DAYS** from the abomination + **1335 DAYS** for the blessed-one-who-waits. The calendrical-arithmetic preserved without harmonization. Maccabean-period referent: the period of the desecration (Antiochene persecution) and the rededication (164 BCE Hasmonean rededication, Hanukkah).

paragraphs.text: אַשְׁרֵ֥י הַֽמְחַכֶּ֖ה וְיַגִּ֑יעַ לְיָמִ֕ים אֶ֕לֶף שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
paragraphs.translit: ʾašrê ham-ḥakkeh wə-yaggîaʿ lə-yāmîm ʾelep̄ šəlōš mēʾōṯ šəlōšîm wa-ḥămiššāh

i18n.en: Blessed is he that waits, and comes to the thousand three hundred and thirty-five days.

paragraphs.text: וְאַתָּ֖ה לֵ֣ךְ לַקֵּ֑ץ וְתָנ֛וּחַ וְתַעֲמֹ֥ד לְגֹרָלְךָ֖ לְקֵ֥ץ הַיָּמִֽין׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʾattāh lēḵ laq-qēṣ wə-ṯānūaḥ wə-ṯaʿămōḏ lə-ḡōrāl-ḵā lə-qēṣ hay-yāmîn

i18n.en: But you go your way till the end be; for you shall rest, and shall stand in your lot at the end of the days."
